metadata.case_name: LAM PO WAI v. I-CABLE COMMUNICATIONS LTD

injuries.description: Although he suffered a crescent shaped cut on the back of his hand, it was described as being 1.5 cm long and superficial.
source: Although he suffered a crescent shaped cut on the back of his hand, it was described as being 1.5 cm long and superficial.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of other parts of wrist or hand

injuries.description: there were three incisions and the operation record shows that there was lunotriquetral longitudinal instability, that the dorsal capsule was avulsed from the dorsal aspect triquetrum and that there was scar tissue around the lunotriquetral interval there was a small central triangular fibro cartilage capsule tear.
source: there were three incisions and the operation record shows that there was lunotriquetral longitudinal instability, that the dorsal capsule was avulsed from the dorsal aspect triquetrum and that there was scar tissue around the lunotriquetral interval there was a small central triangular fibro cartilage capsule tear.

injuries.description: he had sustained an injury to his right hand and right wrist on 19 October.
source: he had sustained an injury to his right hand and right wrist on 19 October.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand, unspecified

manifestations.description: local tenderness at the ulnar region of the right wrist
significant loss of capacity in his right hand; unable to lift heavy weights, particularly with his right hand
unable to handle the sort of equipment which his former employment would require; could not be expected to handle safely heavy lighting equipment
inability to return to his former work as an electrician

treatments_received: medication to protect the stomach from the effects of the anti-inflammatory drug
arthroscopy of the wrist on 7 September 2006 under general anaesthetic (three incisions)
sick leave (continued until 7 June 2008, apart from a short period)

losses.description: He has suffered a significant loss of capacity in his right hand and he is clearly unable to handle the sort of equipment which his former employment would require.
He is unable to return to his former work; he could not be expected to handle safely heavy lighting equipment and is not equipped to be an electrician.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He is able to ride a bicycle on level ground and to swim, but he is not in a position to lift heavy weights, particularly with his right hand.
